title: ラスボスは、まだ死ねない
reward: 白燼の解放と帰還門の地図

scenes.name: 知っている傷
scenes.purpose: 倒した敵への恐怖から相手の痛みに気づく

panels.art: Evening under arena stone stairs. Yun and So Rin face Hakujin; Yun holds ONE bronze disk in left palm, sword sheathed. Hakujin's long white hair low-tied, gold eyes, slate blue robe, RIGHT wrist cracked black seal. Yun hesitates.
panels.speaker: ハン・ユン

panels.art: Hakujin steps into lantern light, weary face, doesn't draw weapon. Yun freezes with hand on sheathed hilt.
panels.speaker: 白燼

panels.art: Close of Hakujin's RIGHT wrist: black cracked seal pulses cyan at cracks; he grips wrist with left hand, sweat and pain. No chains, no blood.
panels.speaker: 白燼

panels.art: Yun lowers sword hand, remembers death was once pixels, troubled compassionate eyes. So Rin notices seal.
panels.speaker: ハン・ユン
panels.text: あの戦い、本当に痛かった？

scenes.name: 敵の命
scenes.purpose: システムが敵を強制していたと知り救う

panels.art: Hakujin's right sealed wrist begins to pull his hand toward Yun against his will; he braces it with left hand, frightened rather than sinister. Yun has not attacked.
panels.speaker: 白燼

panels.art: Yun catches Hakujin's RIGHT forearm gently with his LEFT hand, keeping cursed hand away from people. So Rin watches seriously.
panels.speaker: ハン・ユン
panels.text: それで、何度も戦わされる。

panels.art: Yun draws ONE black sword RIGHT hand, thin cyan edge, surgical narrow arc cuts ONLY black magical seal hovering ABOVE wrist skin. Skin intact, no blood, seal shards dissolve, no severed limb.
panels.speaker: ハン・ユン

panels.art: Hakujin's freed right hand opens; seal is completely gone permanently. He exhales in disbelief, tears only subtle. Yun safely resheathes sword.
panels.speaker: 白燼

scenes.transitionNarration:
夜通し、白燼の話を聞いた。
夜明けの鐘で、印が動き出す。

scenes.name: 知らない帰り道
scenes.purpose: 救った敵が自分の意思で道案内を選ぶ

panels.art: Hakujin gently hands Yun ONE rolled map, right wrist bare unmarked. Bronze disk tucked into Yun's dark red sash, sword sheathed. Smith beside both.
panels.speaker: 白燼
panels.text: 帰還門なら、場所を知ってる。

panels.art: Close map held open by Yun and Hakujin. A mountain gate symbol and bridge illustrated, no printed words. Yun's eyes reflect a chance at home.
panels.speaker: ハン・ユン

panels.art: Hakujin touches now-free right wrist, quietly looks at Yun. Smith attentive, no attack.
panels.speaker: 白燼
panels.text: だが、盟主が道を閉じている。

panels.art: Night palace balcony: alliance chief Go Tensaku in plum gold crane robes looks at a CRACKED black control crystal in his right hand. Menacing composed face, no Hakujin seal returning.
panels.speaker: 呉天策
panels.text: 駒が、勝手に歩き始めたか。
